items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: This boy, I think was named Mason. ... Well, see, Mason first was a concert, was a concert trumpet player.

ctx.x: Did Pops Foster ever play with you? I thought somebody... That's right, Pops was there. He came over here, he did, but he came over here.
Left fate and come with Charlie, yeah. This boy, I think was named Mason.
Oh, yes, I've heard him. Mason. Yeah, sure.
